A modest shallow basin edged by low worn uneven stones holds clear warm spring water coming directly from the ground. Light natural condensation drifts from the water in cool morning air. Around the basin is tamped earth and rough small paving stones; a few low timber-and-brick domestic houses with muted plaster, simple tiled roofs and shuttered windows stand softly in the background. This is a plausible fictional reconstruction, not any exact documented historic pool or room.
Subject: ONE anonymous fictional ADULT Bulgarian townswoman, about 30 years old, kneels centrally beside the shallow basin, seen from behind with her head turned fully away from the camera. Only the back of her plain kerchief and neck are visible: no facial features, not even a side portrait. Entire kneeling adult figure fits in the frame and occupies about one-third of frame height. Her simple everyday nineteenth-century dress consists of a plain dark wool sukman-like long skirt/dress over an off-white long-sleeved shirt, a modest muted brown woven front apron tied at the waist, and a plain cream head kerchief. No festive embroidery, jewelry or copied museum costume. Clothing is natural matte fabric, modestly worn.

Full frame, no border.
Style and light: unmistakably real-camera photorealism with physically convincing water, stone, clay, skin, wool and linen. Soft natural cool morning daylight with subtle warm reflected light, muted earth colors, normal photographic exposure and fine documentary texture. Gentle steam rises from the whole warm water surface and disperses irregularly. No painterly brushwork, no oil painting, no illustration-style strokes, no CGI gloss, no HDR, no theatrical spotlight, no cinematic orange/teal grade or oversaturation.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: photorealistic educational architectural illustration for a Sofia city introduction.
Create ONE completely NEW TEXT-ONLY image, exactly 1536 x 1024 landscape 3:2, opaque RGB PNG in sRGB. No source images, reference pixels or photographic copies.
Scene: Banya Bashi Mosque in central Sofia, in a quiet contemporary early-morning setting. Ground-level geothermal condensation is the subject: small translucent pale wisps emerge from a narrow seam between the worn paving stones close to the mosque wall, just as naturally heated mineral water beneath the site meets cool air. Localized light steam curls upward and disperses, with the surrounding pavement still clearly visible. No water fountain, tap, exposed pipe, industrial outlet or smoke. This is a plausible illustrative placement of the ground vapor, not a claim to reproduce a documented vent position.
Architecture: a plausible exterior detail of the historic sixteenth-century Ottoman mosque. It is a modest square masonry prayer hall beneath a SINGLE broad shallow hemispherical central dome on a low octagonal transition drum; the dome roof has weathered matte GRAY LEAD plates with realistic quiet seams, not terracotta tiles. The wall is built of real carved pale warm-gray stone alternating with narrow bands of muted red brick and light mortar. Simple tall arched windows sit within the wall, with dark glass and unobtrusive fine iron grilles, no painted words or inscriptions. One graceful slender minaret rises behind one corner, mainly pale aged masonry with some muted brickwork, a narrow single balcony with a light stone parapet and a dark gray pointed roof. No exaggerated candy stripes, no fantasy architecture, no second minaret. Keep the building credible and uncluttered.
Composition: low camera viewpoint roughly 40 cm above the pavement, looking gently upward from beside the wall, wide enough to include the foreground vapor seam, the masonry wall in the middle distance, the curved gray dome and the slender minaret rising behind. Natural wide-normal 35mm lens perspective, realistic straight walls, no fisheye or dramatic converging distortions. Pavement seam and rising steam occupy the lower central third and remain legible at small viewing size; wall, dome and minaret remain clearly identifiable. Tight angle and sky keep unrelated contemporary buildings outside the main subject. Empty scene with absolutely NO humans.
Lighting and texture: calm cool early-morning natural daylight, soft gray-blue sky, subtle low sunlight on stone and brick, no dramatic sunbeams. Real photographic exposure, restrained natural colors, detailed matte stone grain, tiny brick irregularities, realistic lead roof, damp-looking joints near the warm seam. Thin white condensed steam, physically plausible, irregular and transparent, not a dense smoke plume. A real-camera documentary photograph appearance, fully photorealistic. Do not render as a drawing or painting.
Avoid: people, worshippers, tourists, faces, vehicles, advertisements, flags, billboards, legible mosque inscriptions, writing, letters, numbers, symbols used as lettering, signs, logos, labels, watermarks, captions or borders. No modern building as a main subject, no huge damaged fissure, no ruins, fire, smoke, explosion, injury, blood, violence, plastic, faucets, exposed pipes or engineered steam chimney. No HDR, painterly texture, illustration strokes, glossy CGI, cinema-style grading, orange/teal palette or oversaturation.
